slogan: Coordinate artistic programming in the new climate regime

features.2: Search for colleagues to share projects

do-good.title: Do good to our planet
do-good.subtitle: Lower the carbon footprint of artistic and audience mobilities

get-inspiration.title: Get inspiration and promote your projects

definitions.0: a platform conceived as a free and open-source common good,
definitions.1: to allow programmers to share and identify converging projects,
definitions.2: to achieve time- and geography-efficient touring
definitions.3: with the aim to limit the ecological footprint of performing arts and music.

stakes-and-values.title: Stakes and Values

definitions.0: We try our best to keep the increase in global temperature well below 2°C, in line with the IPCC recommendations and the legal framework of the Paris Agreement.
definitions.1: The cultural sector has its part to play : we need to build up sustainability through art & sustainability in the arts.
definitions.2: Slowing down, territorialising and coordinating should be the key words for programming in the ecological redirection;
definitions.3: Individual actions aren't enough: we need a coordinated systemic change to lower the footprint of the sector in a significant way.
definitions.4: The richness and diversity of artistic creation and the intercultural exchange are core values and need to be safeguarded.
definitions.5: We need to improve the conditions for sustainable regional, national and international mobility for artists.
definitions.6: CooProg, a tool for coordinated programming in the new Climate Regime is

stakes-and-values.open-source: an open source and free platform
stakes-and-values.tool-to-share: a tool to share project ideas and decide on programming in a coordinated way
stakes-and-values.safe-space: a safe space to freely share ideas on a reciprocal basis
stakes-and-values.decentralized: a decentralized tool, where people decide what they share
